text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Scott Road.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the east side of Scott Road, from a point 27 metres south of Dunraven Drive to a point 5.5 metres further south.
